decisions.reason: A has been maintained on its own webpage across 2023 and 2024, indicating comparatively high investment and visible commitment, which makes management likely to persist unless performance clearly collapses.
B remained on the website in both years, so prior commitment and launch responsibility support continuation, but its lower visibility than A makes it easier to discontinue if results stay mediocre.

D is the newest product and only briefly established on the website, so sunk costs and public commitment are lower, yet management would still likely give it more time and attribute weak early results to a temporary ramp-up phase.
